name: GitHub Developer Platform Integration
description: Integration pack for GitHub, providing connectivity to Git repositories, Pull Request code reviews, GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, Dependabot security alerts, and GitHub Enterprise governance.

capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Integrates GitHub Pull Request review approvals, branch protection rules, and automated code review checks.

capabilities.name: DevOps & CI/CD Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates GitHub Actions build matrix, workflow dispatch triggers, and runner execution tracking.

capabilities.name: Security Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates GitHub Dependabot vulnerability alerts, Secret Scanning, and CodeQL static analysis.

checklists.name: GitHub Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for GitHub Webhook connectivity, OAuth / Personal Access Token scopes, and Action runners.

items.statement: GitHub Webhook secret is configured with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
OAuth App / Personal Access Token permissions satisfy least-privilege repository access scope.
Branch protection rules enforce mandatory Pull Request approvals before merging to main.
GitHub Actions workflow status checks report build pass/fail status back to commits.

reviewGates.name: GitHub Integration Readiness Gate
reviewGates.statement: The DevOps Engineer confirms that GitHub Webhook endpoints and API tokens satisfy security & connectivity standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the GitHub integration setup confirm API token validity and webhook event delivery?

obligationDefinitions.title: GitHub App/token permissions must be reviewed to stay least-privilege
obligationDefinitions.description: A GitHub App installation or PAT's granted permissions can accumulate broader scope than currently needed; scope must be periodically reviewed and narrowed, not left at its original broad grant indefinitely.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: The GitHub App/token's granted scope is reviewed and confirmed least-privilege within the declared cadence.

requiredEvidence.title: Token/App scope review
requiredEvidence.description: Review of granted GitHub App/token permissions against actual usage.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Does the GitHub App/token's granted scope still match actual least-privilege need?
